functions.verify_census_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.verify_census_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
with pages as (
 select j.job_id,j.page_number,j.status,j.params,r.raw_text::jsonb body,r.sha256,r.source_bytes,r.evidence,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(r.raw_text,'UTF8')),'hex') as recomputed_hash
 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.acquisition_job j left join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.acquisition_raw r using(job_id) where j.kind='CENSUS'
), counts as (
 select count(*) pages,count(*) filter(where status='COMPLETE') complete_pages,
 count(*) filter(where sha256 is distinct from recomputed_hash) bad_hash,
 coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(body->'results')),0) raw_rows,
 count(*) filter(where nullif(body->>'next_url','') is null and body is not null and status='COMPLETE') terminal_pages,
 count(*)-count(distinct page_number) duplicate_page_numbers,
 min(page_number) first_page,max(page_number) last_page,
 count(*) filter(where body is null) missing_source_pages from pages
), records as (
 select count(*) normalized_rows,count(distinct ticker) unique_tickers,
 count(*)-count(distinct ticker) duplicate_ticker_rows,
 count(*) filter(where ticker is null or security_type is null) missing_identity_fields,
 count(*) filter(where security_type in('CS','ADRC','OS','NYRS','GDR','OTHER') or security_type is null) candidate_security_rows
 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.reference_row
), links as (
 select count(*) mismatches from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.reference_row r join pages p on p.job_id=r.page_job_id where r.raw_record is distinct from p.body->'results'->(r.ordinal-1) or r.ticker is distinct from r.raw_record->>'ticker' or r.security_type is distinct from r.raw_record->>'type' or r.ordinal<1 or r.ordinal>jsonb_array_length(p.body->'results')
), chain as (
 select count(*) mismatches from pages p left join pages successor on successor.page_number=p.page_number+1
 where (nullif(p.evidence->>'next_cursor','') is not null and (successor.job_id is null or successor.params->>'cursor' is distinct from p.evidence->>'next_cursor'))
 or(nullif(p.body->>'next_url','') is not null and nullif(p.evidence->>'next_cursor','') is null)
 or(nullif(p.body->>'next_url','') is null and successor.job_id is not null)
 or population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.query_cursor_v1(p.body->>'next_url') is distinct from nullif(p.evidence->>'next_cursor','')
)
select jsonb_build_object('verification','INDEPENDENT_RAW_PAGE_RECONCILIATION_V1','observed_at',now(),'pages',to_jsonb(c),'records',to_jsonb(r),'raw_record_mismatches',l.mismatches,'page_chain_mismatches',ch.mismatches,
'census_page_reconciliation_pass',c.complete_pages=c.pages and c.pages>0 and c.first_page=1 and c.last_page=c.pages and c.terminal_pages=1 and c.bad_hash=0 and c.missing_source_pages=0 and c.duplicate_page_numbers=0 and c.raw_rows=r.normalized_rows and r.duplicate_ticker_rows=0 and l.mismatches=0 and ch.mismatches=0,
'type_counts',(select jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(security_type,'MISSING'),n) from(select security_type,count(*) n from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.reference_row group by security_type)t),
'company_universe_certified',false,'limitations','Verifies retained provider page structure and normalization only. Company identities, full eligible-company census, caps, ADR/class semantics, independent source comparison and top3000 cutoff remain unresolved.') from counts c cross join records r cross join links l cross join chain ch;
$function$
functions.macro_normalize_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_normalize_v1(p_attempt uuid, p_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare tid uuid;t population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task%rowtype;before_n integer;after_n integer;expected_n integer;h text;
begin
 tid:=population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_assert_attempt_v1(p_attempt,p_token);
 select * into t from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task where task_id=tid;
 if t.partition_key not in('headline','revision','warmup') then raise exception 'MACRO_PARTITION_NOT_ADMITTED';end if;
 select count(*) into before_n from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation where family_id='CTX07' and partition_key=t.partition_key;
INSERT INTO population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document
 (source_id,source_sha256,source_uri,source_provider,retrieved_at,source_published_at,historical_received_at,content_text,content_external_uri,content_bytes,evidence,license_policy)
SELECT 'CTX07:'||r.source_id,coalesce(r.raw_sha256,r.payload_sha256),r.source_url,r.source_kind,r.received_at,
 (SELECT min(o.released_at) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_observations o WHERE o.source_id=r.source_id),NULL,
 CASE WHEN r.raw_sha256 IS NULL THEN r.payload_text ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN r.raw_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN r.source_url ELSE NULL END,
 NULL,jsonb_build_object('typed_source_id',r.source_id,'exact_metadata_sha256',r.payload_sha256,'retained_hash_only_reason','Original government source is retained in separately hashed evidence bundle; raw publisher URL is not asserted immutable. ISM article bodies are not retained.','metadata',r.evidence),
 CASE WHEN r.source_kind LIKE '%ISM%' OR r.source_url LIKE '%prnewswire.com%' THEN 'PUBLIC_METADATA_ONLY_USAGE_RIGHTS_QUALIFICATION_PENDING' ELSE 'OFFICIAL_GOVERNMENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE' END
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_source_registry r
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

WITH selected AS (
 SELECT o.*,CASE o.record_role WHEN 'existing_warmup' THEN 'warmup' ELSE o.record_role END AS partition_key,
 CASE WHEN o.record_role='existing_warmup' THEN 'SUPPORT' ELSE 'TARGET' END AS time_role,
 COALESCE((o.payload->>'prior_print_as_known')::numeric,p.actual) AS earlier_headline_print
 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_observations o
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT q.actual FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_observations q
  WHERE q.factor_name=o.factor_name AND q.released_at<o.released_at
   AND q.record_role IN ('headline','existing_warmup')
  ORDER BY q.released_at DESC LIMIT 1
 ) p ON true
 WHERE o.record_role IN ('headline','revision','existing_warmup')
  AND (CASE o.record_role WHEN 'existing_warmup' THEN 'warmup' ELSE o.record_role END)=t.partition_key
  AND o.factor_name NOT IN ('ism_manufacturing_pmi_as_released','ism_services_pmi_as_released')
), shaped AS (
 SELECT s.*,jsonb_build_object('factor_name',factor_name,'actual',actual,'units',units,'reference_period',reference_period,'released_at',released_at,'available_at',available_at,'prior_print_as_known',earlier_headline_print,'consensus',NULL,'surprise',NULL) AS values_json,
 jsonb_build_object('actual','VALUE','units','VALUE','reference_period','VALUE','released_at','VALUE','available_at','VALUE','prior_print_as_known',CASE WHEN earlier_headline_print IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' ELSE 'VALUE' END) AS field_state,
 jsonb_build_object('typed_observation_id',observation_id,'exact_payload_sha256',payload_sha256,'source_content_sha256',source_content_sha256,'record_role',record_role,'qualification',qualification,'publication_time_basis','OFFICIAL_PUBLICATION_HEADER_RECONSTRUCTION','historical_receipt',NULL,'prior_is_not_revised_same_release',true) AS lineage
 FROM selected s
)
INSERT INTO population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation
 (family_id,partition_key,unit_key,time_role,event_at,effective_date,source_published_at,historical_received_at,available_at,availability_policy,vintage_key,source_id,source_record_key,normalization_sha256,values_json,field_state,lineage,record_sha256)
SELECT 'CTX07',partition_key,source_key,time_role,released_at,(reference_period AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,released_at,NULL,available_at,
 'PUBLICATION_SUPPORTED_RECONSTRUCTION',released_at::text,'CTX07:'||source_id,source_key,payload_sha256,values_json,field_state,lineage,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('values',values_json,'states',field_state,'lineage',lineage)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
FROM shaped
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.expected_observation
 (family_id,partition_key,unit_key,time_role,required_fields,expectation_source_id,expectation_record_key,applicability_evidence)
SELECT 'CTX07',CASE record_role WHEN 'existing_warmup' THEN 'warmup' WHEN 'ism_metadata_candidate' THEN 'headline' ELSE record_role END,
 source_key,CASE WHEN record_role='existing_warmup' THEN 'SUPPORT' ELSE 'TARGET' END,
 ARRAY['actual','reference_period','released_at','available_at','units','prior_print_as_known'],
 'CTX07:'||source_id,source_key,
 jsonb_build_object('factor_name',factor_name,'record_role',record_role,'exact21_series_scope',true,
 'publication_header_verified',true,'rights_status',CASE WHEN factor_name LIKE 'ism_%' THEN 'PENDING_USAGE_RIGHTS_QUALIFICATION' ELSE 'OFFICIAL_GOVERNMENT_SOURCE' END,
 'denominator_status',CASE WHEN record_role='revision' THEN 'PROVISIONAL' ELSE 'ENUMERATED_SOURCE_RELEASES' END,
 'revision_source_index_complete',CASE WHEN record_role='revision' THEN false ELSE NULL END,
 'required_revision_source_index_check',CASE WHEN record_role='revision' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' ELSE NULL END,
 'revision_scope_note',CASE WHEN record_role='revision' THEN '15 explicit relevant prior-period revisions enumerated. Census September28 annual table evidence retained separately. Exhaustive relevant revision-index coverage not yet certified.' ELSE NULL END)
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.macro_observations
WHERE (CASE record_role WHEN 'existing_warmup' THEN 'warmup' WHEN 'ism_metadata_candidate' THEN 'headline' ELSE record_role END)=t.partition_key
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

 select count(*),encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(unit_key||':'||record_sha256||E'\n','' order by unit_key),'UTF8')),'hex') into after_n,h
 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation where family_id='CTX07' and partition_key=t.partition_key;
 select count(*) into expected_n from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.expected_observation where family_id='CTX07' and partition_key=t.partition_key;
 if after_n<>(case t.partition_key when 'headline' then 39 when 'revision' then 15 else 19 end) or expected_n<>(case t.partition_key when 'headline' then 43 when 'revision' then 15 else 21 end) then raise exception 'MACRO_NORMALIZED_COUNTS_MISMATCH';end if;
 insert into population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_partition(family_id,partition_key,time_role,denominator_state,denominator_evidence,producer_revision,immutable_input_versions,publication_eligible)
 values('CTX07',t.partition_key,case when t.partition_key='warmup' then 'SUPPORT' else 'TARGET' end,'PROVISIONAL',
 jsonb_build_object('source_expected_units',expected_n,'source_observed_units',after_n,'basis','Enumeration of retained original release headers and prior source-backed support; exhaustive release/revision index not independently certified','ism_rights_unresolved',t.partition_key<>'revision','strict_historical_receipts',0),
 'macro-bridge-v2',t.input_versions,false) on conflict(family_id,partition_key)do nothing;
 return jsonb_build_object('state','COMPLETE','commit_receipt',jsonb_build_object('commit_key','macro-normalized:'||t.partition_key||':'||h,'input_versions',t.input_versions,
 'immutable_output_ids',jsonb_build_array('CTX07:'||t.partition_key),'output_sha256',h,'new_committed_units',after_n-before_n,'expected_units',expected_n,'received_units',after_n,'original_receipt_qualified',0));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_full_gate_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
with facts as(select
 (select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.catalog_family_contract) contract_count,
 (select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_company) company_count,
 (select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_instrument) instrument_count,
 (select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_exception where resolved_at is null) unresolved_exceptions,
 (select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task where status='BLOCKED') blocked_tasks,
 not exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.catalog_family_contract c left join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_family_binding b using(family_id)
 where b.family_id is null or not b.partition_manifest_frozen or b.expected_partition_count is null or b.partition_manifest_sha256 is null
 or b.expected_partition_count<>(select count(*) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_partition p where p.family_id=c.family_id)
 or exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_partition p left join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_validation v on v.validation_id=p.last_validation_id where p.family_id=c.family_id and (p.denominator_state<>'FROZEN' or not p.publication_eligible or v.result is distinct from 'PASS'))) all_families_pass,
 exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_universe where singleton and status='FROZEN' and company_count=3000 and unresolved_cutoff_cases=0 and unresolved_instrument_cases=0 and company_manifest_sha256 is not null and instrument_manifest_sha256 is not null and verification_evidence is not null) universe_pass)
select to_jsonb(facts)||jsonb_build_object('full_gate_pass',contract_count=24 and company_count=3000 and instrument_count>=3000 and unresolved_exceptions=0 and blocked_tasks=0 and all_families_pass and universe_pass) from facts;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.population_read_asof_v1(p_asof timestamp with time zone, p_strict_receipt boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(publication_id uuid, family_id text, partition_key text, unit_key text, observation jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql

functions.resource_probe_claim_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_claim_v1(p_probe_id uuid, p_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_probe population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1%rowtype;
 v_control population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.acquisition_control%rowtype;
 v_pipeline population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_control%rowtype;v_hash text;
BEGIN
 IF p_probe_id IS NULL OR p_token IS NULL OR p_token!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RETURN '{"state":"DENIED"}';END IF;
 v_hash:=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_probe_id::text||':'||p_token,'UTF8')),'hex');
 -- Reject unknown capabilities before locking mission controls.
 SELECT * INTO v_probe FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1
  WHERE probe_id=p_probe_id AND token_sha256=v_hash AND state='PENDING' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp();
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN '{"state":"DENIED"}';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_control FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.acquisition_control WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO v_pipeline FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_control WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO v_probe FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1 WHERE probe_id=p_probe_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF v_probe.probe_attempt IS DISTINCT FROM 3 OR v_probe.max_runtime_ms IS DISTINCT FROM 30000
  OR v_probe.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'PENDING' OR v_probe.token_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v_hash OR v_probe.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()+interval '31 seconds'
  OR v_control.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_probe.owner_id OR v_control.owner_fence IS DISTINCT FROM v_probe.owner_fence
  OR v_control.stop_generation IS DISTINCT FROM v_probe.stop_generation OR v_probe.owner_fence<>2 OR v_probe.stop_generation<>0
  OR v_control.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'top3000-recovery-20261023-root-4b1314bcb5c2'
  OR v_pipeline.expected_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_control.owner_id OR v_pipeline.expected_owner_fence IS DISTINCT FROM v_control.owner_fence
  OR v_pipeline.expected_stop_generation IS DISTINCT FROM v_control.stop_generation
  OR v_control.scope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v_probe.scope_sha256 OR v_pipeline.scope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v_probe.scope_sha256
  OR v_control.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM true OR v_control.stopped IS DISTINCT FROM false OR v_control.hold_reason IS NOT NULL
  OR v_control.admitted_until IS NULL OR v_control.admitted_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR v_pipeline.deadline IS NULL OR v_pipeline.deadline<=clock_timestamp()
  OR v_pipeline.budget_verified_at IS NULL OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,allowed}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,worker}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'population-top3000-resource-v1'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,probe_attempt}' IS DISTINCT FROM '3'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,max_lifetime_invocations}' IS DISTINCT FROM '3'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,max_invocations}' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence#>>'{resource_probe_admission,max_usd}' IS DISTINCT FROM '2.01'
  OR v_pipeline.budget_evidence->>'provider_admissions_allowed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1 prior_probe WHERE prior_probe.probe_attempt=1 AND prior_probe.state='FAILED' AND prior_probe.result->>'error_code'='UNKNOWN_READ_OUTCOME')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1 prior_probe WHERE prior_probe.probe_attempt=2 AND prior_probe.state='FAILED'
   AND prior_probe.result->>'error_code'='CONTROL_RESULT_SERIALIZATION_REJECTED' AND prior_probe.result->>'root_cause'='POSTGRES345_JSONB_DOUBLE_SERIALIZATION')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event proof WHERE proof.event='RESOURCE_PROBE_JSON_SERIALIZATION_CAUSE_VERIFIED'
   AND proof.details->>'result'='CONFIRMED' AND proof.details->>'owner_fence'='2' AND proof.details->>'probe_attempt'='2'
   AND proof.details->>'validation_error'='INVALID_SANITIZED_PROBE_RESULT' AND proof.details->>'root_cause'='POSTGRES345_JSONB_DOUBLE_SERIALIZATION'
   AND proof.details->>'local_test_sha256'='e228ca07add51f48a3f1e04cd3e80b0bbf1652c57d2c3a08c89919aea84c2f21')
  OR v_pipeline.unavoidable_usd<v_probe.encumbered_usd*3 OR v_control.http_invocations<v_probe.http_invocation_ordinal
  OR (v_pipeline.actual_usd+v_pipeline.accrued_usd+v_pipeline.unavoidable_usd+v_pipeline.remaining_uncommitted_usd+v_pipeline.repair_egress_reserve_usd+v_pipeline.reserved_request_usd<=250) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RETURN '{"state":"DENIED"}';END IF;
 UPDATE population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.resource_probe_v1
 SET state='RUNNING',claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),claim_deadline_at=least(expires_at,clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds')
 WHERE probe_id=p_probe_id AND state='PENDING';
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','CLAIMED','probe_id',p_probe_id,'max_response_bytes',2097152,'total_timeout_ms',30000,'probe_attempt',3);
END $function$
functions.pipeline_relation_hash_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_relation_hash_v1(p_relation oid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

AS $function$
select encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('namespace',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,

functions.company_verify_overviews_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.company_verify_overviews_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
with expected as (
 select r.ticker from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.reference_row r
 where r.security_type in('CS','ADRC','OS','NYRS','GDR','OTHER') or r.security_type is null
), checked as (
 select e.ticker,o.source_job_id,o.snapshot_date,o.raw_record,a.sha256,a.raw_text,
 case when a.raw_text is null then null else a.raw_text::jsonb end doc
 from expected e left join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.ticker_overview o on o.ticker=e.ticker and o.snapshot_date='2026-08-03'
 left join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.acquisition_raw a on a.job_id=o.source_job_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_measure_partition_v1(p_family text, p_partition text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare b jsonb;m jsonb;q text;
begin
 b:=population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_bound_relations_v1(p_family);
 if b->>'state'<>'BOUND' then return b;end if;
 q:=format($sql$
 with e as materialized(select x.*,to_jsonb(x) whole from %s x where release_id='top3000_companies_202608_202609_v1' and family_id=$1 and partition_key=$2),
 o as materialized(select x.*,to_jsonb(x) whole from %s x where release_id='top3000_companies_202608_202609_v1' and family_id=$1 and partition_key=$2),
 fields as(select e.unit_key,f.name,o.unit_key observed_key,o.values_json->f.name val,o.field_state->>f.name state,o.lineage,
  o.availability_policy,o.historical_received_at,
  coalesce((e.applicability_evidence->>'strict_receipt_required')::boolean,false) strict_required
  from e cross join lateral unnest(e.required_fields) f(name) left join o using(unit_key)),
 unit_counts as(select (select count(*) from e) expected_units,(select count(*) from o) received_units,
  (select count(*)-count(distinct unit_key) from e) duplicate_expected_units,(select count(*)-count(distinct unit_key) from o) duplicate_observed_units,
  (select count(*) from e left join o using(unit_key) where o.unit_key is null) missing_units,
  (select count(*) from o left join e using(unit_key) where e.unit_key is null) unexpected_units,
  (select encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(whole::text,E'\n' order by unit_key),''),'UTF8')),'hex') from e) expected_manifest_sha256,
  (select encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(whole::text,E'\n' order by unit_key),''),'UTF8')),'hex') from o) observed_manifest_sha256,
  (select count(*) from e where cardinality(required_fields)=0 or time_role not in('TARGET','SUPPORT') or not exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document d where d.source_id=e.expectation_source_id))+
  (select count(*) from o where jsonb_typeof(values_json) is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(field_state) is distinct from 'object'
    or record_sha256 is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('values',values_json,'states',field_state,'lineage',lineage)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
    or not exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document d where d.source_id=o.source_id and (d.content_text is null or d.source_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(d.content_text,'UTF8')),'hex')))) structural_failures,
  (select count(*) from e join o using(unit_key) where e.company_id is distinct from o.company_id or e.security_id is distinct from o.security_id or e.reporting_entity_id is distinct from o.reporting_entity_id or e.time_role is distinct from o.time_role) membership_failures,
  (select count(*) from o where availability_policy not in('ARCHIVED_OBSERVATION','PUBLICATION_SUPPORTED_RECONSTRUCTION','ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_OBSERVED','CONSERVATIVE_ASSUMPTION','UNKNOWN')
   or (availability_policy='ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_OBSERVED' and (historical_received_at is null or available_at is null or available_at<historical_received_at))
   or (availability_policy='PUBLICATION_SUPPORTED_RECONSTRUCTION' and (source_published_at is null or available_at is null or available_at<source_published_at))
   or (available_at is not null and source_published_at is not null and available_at<source_published_at)
   or (historical_received_at is not null and historical_received_at>ingested_at)) temporal_failures),
 field_counts as(select count(*) required_fields,
  count(*) filter(where observed_key is not null and state in('VERIFIED_VALUE','VALUE','PRESENT') and val is not null and val<>'null'::jsonb) verified_value_fields,
  count(*) filter(where observed_key is not null and state='NOT_APPLICABLE' and coalesce(lineage->'field_evidence'->name->>'reason','')<>'' and lineage->'field_evidence'->name ? 'source_id') not_applicable_fields,
  count(*) filter(where observed_key is not null and state='PUBLISHED_MISSING' and lineage->'field_evidence'->name ? 'source_id') published_missing_fields,
  count(*) filter(where state='UNAVAILABLE' or (strict_required and historical_received_at is null)) unavailable_fields,
  count(*) filter(where state='CONFLICTING') conflicting_fields,count(*) filter(where state='QUARANTINED') quarantined_fields,
  count(*) filter(where observed_key is null or state is null or state not in('VERIFIED_VALUE','VALUE','PRESENT','NOT_APPLICABLE','PUBLISHED_MISSING','UNAVAILABLE','CONFLICTING','QUARANTINED')
   or (state in('VERIFIED_VALUE','VALUE','PRESENT') and (val is null or val='null'::jsonb))
   or (state='NOT_APPLICABLE' and not(coalesce(lineage->'field_evidence'->name->>'reason','')<>'' and coalesce(lineage->'field_evidence'->name ? 'source_id',false)))
   or (state='PUBLISHED_MISSING' and not coalesce(lineage->'field_evidence'->name ? 'source_id',false))) missing_required_fields,
  count(*) filter(where observed_key is not null and historical_received_at is not null and availability_policy='ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_OBSERVED' and state in('VERIFIED_VALUE','VALUE','PRESENT') and val is not null and val<>'null'::jsonb) strict_receipt_fields from fields)
 select to_jsonb(unit_counts)||to_jsonb(field_counts)||jsonb_build_object('state','MEASURED') from unit_counts cross join field_counts
 $sql$,b->>'expected',b->>'observed');
 execute q into m using p_family,p_partition;
 return m;
end $function$
